Describe the trigger, resulting behavior and reason for the change.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant source and unit checks completed.
- [ ] Package identity, version and file parity checked when packaging is affected.
- [ ] Mac, iPad and iPhone observations are recorded separately; untested platforms are marked pending.
- [ ] Private note data, credentials and local configuration are excluded.

Related issue: use `refs` while device acceptance remains incomplete. A merge or successful source check does not automatically complete device acceptance.
